intro: To explain habits, connect frequency, activity and effect; the expressions часто, редко, регулярно give concrete information.

piezas.titulo: To explain habits, connect frequency, activity and effect; the expressions часто, редко, регулярно give concrete information.
texto: To explain habits, connect frequency, activity and effect; the expressions часто, редко, регулярно give concrete information.
The verbs советовать, рекомендовать and помогать take different complements; learn the full construction.

frases.alumno: The doctor recommended that the patient walk more.
Sleeping regularly helps you concentrate better.

pregunta.texto: What was recommended to the patient?

opciones.explicacion: The first sentence states the recommendation directly.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Врач рекомендовал пациенту больше гулять.»

opciones.texto: The doctor recommended that the patient walk more.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: Sleeping regularly helps you concentrate better.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: Sleeping regularly helps you concentrate better.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
